sections.changelog: Keeps the optional legacy bridge aligned with the theme's rolling-date consistency release.
sections.description: Legacy bridge for older InfoSecNexus installs. Current toolkit features are bundled into the InfoSecNexus theme.

sections.changelog: * Adds the reversible Neumorphic Editorial presentation layer across newsroom, archive, article, search, special, legal, and error views while preserving existing WordPress content and behavior. * Keeps light and dark modes visually coherent with responsive raised and inset surfaces, accessible interaction states, reduced-motion support, and a circular reading-progress control.
